propositions: A new `rebar metrics` CLI subcommand must parse `--since` and `--until` date-range flags and `--output json|text` format selection
The command must evaluate all MetricSpec entries in the registry over the specified date range and render each metric with its value, source, confidence, and lens or unavailability reason
The command must be routed via an explicit `if sub == "metrics":` dispatch arm in the CLI that first ensures store initialization and imports the full `rebar.metrics` package to hydrate the registry
The JSON output must include all registered metric ids with either value metadata or unavailable reasons; text output must list one metric per line in registry order
Per-metric exceptions during evaluation must be caught and rendered as unavailable rather than crashing the entire command
Adapter-isolation must be enforced: the command source must not directly import any `rebar.metrics.adapters` module
